usageNotes: Use this to start or resume all (or a filtered subset of) guests cluster-wide in a single call — useful after a planned maintenance window or cluster reboot. The caller must hold VM.PowerMgmt on '/' for a blanket start or on each individual '/vms/<ID>' when scoping via the 'vms' parameter. The operation is asynchronous: the response is a UPID that can be polled for completion.

examples.summary: Bulk-start a specific set of VMs with increased parallelism and a 120-second timeout

tips: Omit 'vms' to target every guest in the cluster — ensure you have VM.PowerMgmt on '/' before doing so.
Use 'max-workers' (not the deprecated 'maxworkers') to tune parallelism; the default of 4 is conservative and safe for most clusters.
The 'timeout' parameter applies only to VMs, not to LXC containers.
Poll the returned UPID via the tasks API (GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status) to confirm all guests reached the running state.
